posts.name: The Burning Stickman
posts.cooked:
Citizen Dawn was raiding The Block, hoping to recruit some of the prisoners there to join the Citizens of the Dawn. Dark Watch Expatriette gathered Darkwatch Mr. Fixer, Absolute Zero and the Dark Visionary to stop here, and while her powers and followers multiplied, and Expatriette fell to Citizen Winter, the rest of the heroes whittled Dawn down until she was taken out during a riot as Char blasted everything he saw.

(Also, I've never beaten Dawn without having any ongoing destruction the whole game -- Expat never got her RPG launcher, AZ only got Fueled Freeze after his last turn and DV only got Mental Divergence then, too. Also discovered some neat synergy with DW Fixer and AZ -- destroy his Cryo Chamber -- or any other equipment -- then have AZ pull it back out of the trash for some quick damage/healing)
